{{Quote|It's of the Sith. This place&hellip; it's a tomb of some kind. That armor&hellip; it's ''infested'' with the dark side of the Force.|[[Ekim Ryelli]], to [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]]|<ref name="SWI" />}}
'''Nicht Ka''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]], a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] within the [[Stygian Caldera]], which was located in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
Nicht Ka was located along the [[Nache Bhelfia]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], between [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="TEA" />

A cold, barren [[rock]] affected by [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] rains, Nicht Ka was uninhabitable, although an hexagonal structure was built in its [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] to contain [[Warb Null]]'s unique [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and suit of [[Armor/Legends|battle armor]].<ref name="SWI" />
